messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a production canary spike on paged-warp Flash variant when quantized to fp8. Several requests hit NaNs in softmax and we saw tail latency jumps + OOM-ish GPU errors. attaching quick logs.

kevin: Ugh. Any repro on CI or only canary?

maria: Only on canary (dedicated pool, burst enabled). Repro script is flaky but I can share a deterministic prompt that triggers it ~1/20. Errors show `softmax: inf` and then later `attn_out: nan`.

maria: ```
E 03:12:08.345 softmax_kernel.cu:142 softmax overflow detected: max_logit=1.2e5, scale=1.0
E 03:12:08.346 attn_run.cu:231 write_nan_detected: true
GPU 0: OOM? scratch=0x0
```

ryan: That max_logit is huge. Could be kw caching + batched prefix growth where kv scaling goes wrong in fp8 path. Did kernel selector prefer paged-flashx over stable-flash because of batch size heuristics?

maria: Yes, selector picked `paged-warp-flash` at seq=2048 with batch=8. Selector logs: `chosen_kernel=paged_warp_flash`, `score=0.87`, `fallback_allowed=true`.

kevin: Do we have perf traces? flamegraph/profiler for that run?

perf-bot: perf trace: https://perf.redwood/internal/trace/2467890123 (flamegraph + kernel timelines). Shows repeated softmax kernel invocations with steep memory traffic.

kevin: Opening the trace — looks like prefix KV prefetch merges a few batches and the quantized accumulator path uses a different scaling clamp. Might be missing a pre-softmax re-scale when merging cached prefixes across different quantization metadata.

ryan: Hypothesis: when KV cache was populated by mixed precision calls (some bf16 warmup then fp8 path), the stored kv scale metadata wasn't applied on fetch, so logits can blow up when summing. This only surfaces for paged attention because of the split loads.

maria: Repro steps I ran: `./tools/repro --model gptx-small --seq 2048 --batch 8 --fp8 --paged-atten --seed 42 --prompt crashcase.txt`

kevin: Quick mitigation: force kernel selector to prefer stable flash or fused fallback for now. You can set `ATTN_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=stable,fused` on canary nodes. That should avoid the paged load path.

ryan: Another short-term fix: clamp logits before softmax. e.g. `logits = min(logits, logits_mean + 50.0f)` or apply `exp_clip` on GPU softmax. Ugly but buys time.

maria: Trying kernel pref change now on canary pool. Will also try softmax clamp in a patched runtime locally.

ci-bot: Deploy job #5467 started for attn-selector toggle.

maria: After switching to `stable` kernel, errors dropped to 0 in the next 2k requests. Latency regressed by ~7% but system stable.

kevin: Good. For root cause we need to audit KV meta flow across serialization boundaries. Add unit test that simulates mixed-precision population + paged reload. Also add an invariant assert when loading kv pages: `page.scale == expected_scale` or fallback to decode.

ryan: I'll own the selector change to ensure we prefer precision-safe kernels when `fp8==true` and `kv_cached==true`. Patch: https://git.redwood/repo/attn/+/fix/fp8-kv-sanity (WIP).

maria: Also adding a perf bench: `bench/kv_mix_test --seq 2048 --batch 8 --warmup-bf16 3 --fp8 5 --repeat 1000` to reproduce scaling drift. If anyone wants to run locally, use Cuda 12.3 + Pascal compat.

kevin: Add a regression alert on the console when NaN count > 0 for real traffic so we can auto-roll back.

maria: Will follow up with a minimal failing test in PR and a canary plan to re-enable paged-warp after fixes. Owner: ryan (selector + tests), maria (repro + canary), kevin (runtime softmax guard review).

ryan: Plan timeline: patch + unit tests today, canary re-run tomorrow, restore kernel if green next week.

maria: Thanks. Keeping thread open for logs, feel free to ping me if you see similar on other pools. :eyes:
